notes: WRITTEN 2026-08-06, RETROSPECTIVELY. The machine-contract standard (CLAUDE.md 4.6 / docs/PD_EPISODE_SPEC_STANDARD.v001.md) was added 2026-08-03 and specs existed only from EP54 on, so check_episode_inputs.py refused this episode outright and nothing about it could be verified. Owner authorised writing it. Every value below is MEASURED from this episode's own artefacts unless the field says otherwise; where a channel default was taken, this note says so explicitly. || runtime_seconds MEASURED: ffprobe on 08_edit/willingham_final_bgm.v001.mp4 = 1229.367s (20:29). v002 in the same directory has an identical duration but is a superseded render; v001 is the sha the 2026-08-05 shipped-frame review and acceptance_receipt.v003.json are both bound to (29f990e8...). The band is the measured length +/-2% rounded outward to the nearest 10s = 1200-1260. WHY 2%: the film json is deterministic, so re-rendering the same build reproduces the length to the frame; the band exists to catch a DIFFERENT or TRUNCATED film. 2% (24.6s) is narrower than the shortest real section of this film (OP, 34.3s), so losing any section fails the band, while a caption or BGM tail re-time of a few seconds does not. An 8s hook cannot be caught by any duration band and this one does not pretend to. NOT the channel default 1620-1920: this is a 20-minute film by the owner's explicit decision, recorded in approvals/APR-0001.json. || script_words MEASURED: 06_audio/narration_index.v001.json totals.words = 3,593 over 218 spoken chunks at 189.7 wpm, i.e. the narration actually voiced, which is what the standard's band refers to -- NOT the word count of _planning/EP51_willingham_script.en.v001.md, which carries front-matter, a runtime block and three self-check appendices. Band = 3,593 +/-3% rounded outward = 3,480-3,710. WHY 3% and not the 2% used for runtime: a permitted line-level rewrite moves the word count more than it moves the clock. || section_vocabulary MEASURED: the distinct act labels on the cuts of remotion/src/data/willingham_film.json, in first-appearance order -- HOOK, OP, ACT_1, ACT_2, ACT_3, ENDING. The four 'the man/person on screen is <name>' entries encode the four real-person-likeness rejections of 2026-08-05: a synthetic face carded 'JOHNNY WEBB' at 7:46, a face carded 'GERALD HURST' at 10:48, a front-on portrait read as Willingham at 0:33 under 'for murdering his own children', and -- worst -- a lower-third reading 'CRAIG BEYLER / Fire scientist hired by the Texas Forensic Science Commission' laid over AR-6125684__a_woman_in_jail.mp4, real archive footage of an identifiable woman prisoner with legible forearm tattoos. No filename keyword can catch that class: the offence is the CARD, so it is recorded here as a claim. || PROSE CONSTRAINTS WITH NO SINGLE KEYWORD, recorded here rather than invented into a machine list: no readable fake documents (legible confession, autopsy, verdict, newspaper, case citation, date, license plate); anonymised human presence is REQUIRED and is not the same as a ban on people -- adults only, from behind / in shadow / hatted / hands-only / cropped below the eyes; the ~20 arson indicators stay soft-cited as the ledger hedges them; no global haze/fog/mist/vignette wash and no scanline or CRT texture (screen-wash opacity <= 0.07); no `depth` treatment on footage or stills. || approved_deviations mirrors approvals/APR-0001.json accepted_deviations verbatim -- the owner's decision of 2026-07-31 on acceptance_receipt v003, not a default and not a softening: nothing reads this field.
